description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The Coca-Cola Company is hiring an Azure Integration Developer to build and deploy cloud-based middleware and integration solutions that connect enterprise systems. The role contributes to Azure microservices and API Management development, testing, troubleshooting, and CI/CD delivery while collaborating with senior developers and cross-functional teams.
Azure integration developer building microservices, API Management layers, and automated enterprise system deployments

Responsibilities:
• Assist in translating business requirements, user stories, and technical specifications into working middleware IT solutions
• Build and deploy scalable Azure cloud solutions using established microservices architectures and Enterprise Integration Patterns
• Help implement secure API Management layers to expose backend systems to internal applications and external partners
• Write effective unit and integration tests, and actively participate in code reviews to ensure reliability and code quality
• Work closely with senior developers, architects, and cross-functional teams to integrate diverse systems, continuously learning best practices for enterprise-scale integration
• Assist in investigating defects and performance issues in internal applications, providing fixes, and deploying new versions via automated pipelines
• Follow company development and security standards, and help maintain clear, accurate application documentation
• Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies, contributing to a team that continuously delivers high-quality code to production

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
• 1–3 years of software application development experience
• C#.NET or Java preferred
• 1+ years of hands-on exposure to Azure cloud-based development
• Familiarity with or project experience using Azure Integration Services, such as Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, EventHub, KeyVault, or Azure API Management (APIM)
• Understanding of RESTful API development concepts and familiarity with tools like Swagger/OpenAPI
• Basic scripting skills for automation (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python)
• Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies and basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub
• Foundational understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and an eagerness to learn enterprise systems engineering principles
